summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International furnished a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) disclosing its unaudited interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, alongside a companion Hong Kong Stock Exchange interim results announcement. First-half 2026 revenue rose 29% year-over-year to US$44.5 million (RMB302.2 million) on higher product sales, and the company reported nine registrational Phase III trials in progress, including four cleared by the FDA and EMA. Management additions — Dr. Faical Miyara as Chief Business Officer and Mr. James Ziegler as Chief Commercial Officer — are routine executive appointments, not abrupt departures.
